description: Administers team members. action invite SENDS REAL INVITATION EMAILS to the given addresses (up to 20 per request). action invite_link returns the workspace invitation link and its expiresAt, as the Invite modal shows it, creating one valid for 7 days when none is active; anyone who opens it can request to join. action update_member changes an existing member's role or status: the member is identified by userId or email (both must match if supplied), plus roleId and/or status; omitted fields keep their current values; a member who has no role assigned yet (e.g. a still pending invite) has no role to keep, so roleId is required with the change and the request is rejected without it. action remove_member removes another member from this workspace (userId or email, both must match if supplied): their status becomes inactive and they show as left (a declined request leaves the list rather than showing as left), it permanently revokes their API keys and MCP connections for this workspace, disconnects the mailboxes and LinkedIn accounts they connected here, pauses their routines and frees an active member's seat; for a member waiting for approval it declines the request. It SENDS A REAL EMAIL telling the removed member that their access ended (none for a declined request). Records they own stay. To return they ask to join again with an invitation link, and an admin has to approve the request; the caller cannot remove themselves, the only active membership of the last Customermates platform operator, a member who already left or the last active admin. last-admin protection is enforced server-side, so the workspace cannot lose its last active admin. invite requires create permission on users, as does invite_link; update_member requires update permission on users (Edit on Users & Roles), the same check as REST POST /v1/members/update, and remove_member requires the same permission as REST POST /v1/members/remove.

action.description: invite = send invitation emails (emails); invite_link = return the workspace invitation link for the caller to share; update_member = change an existing member's role or status (userId or email plus roleId and/or status); remove_member = remove another member from this workspace (userId or email).

email.description: update_member and remove_member actions: member email; provide email or userId, and both must match when supplied

emails.description: invite action: required, 1 to 20 email addresses, each receives a real invitation email

roleId.description: update_member action: id of the new role. Omit to keep the current role.

status.description: update_member action: new status. Omit to keep the current status.

userId.description: update_member and remove_member actions: user id of the member; provide userId or email

name: manage_team

outputSchema.description: action invite returns sent, failed, failedEmails and message; invite_link returns link, expiresAt and message; update_member returns email, roleId, status and message; remove_member returns userId, email, previousStatus and message.

title: Manage team
